cluster_inventory.level: Global integrated clustering / HLCA label transfer
cluster_inventory.object: All cells from airway wall biopsies (pwCF and healthy controls) after integration with HLCA reference
cluster_inventory.tissue_condition: Bronchial biopsies; CF carina (EMC) and healthy carina (UCdA) / 3rd-6th generation airways (UMCG)
cluster_inventory.note: 17 cell types reported using HLCA consensus labels; one 'unknown' population was manually annotated as CD8+ T cells based on marker gene expression. No separate subclustering level is described.

verifications.source_context: we did detect a small subset of neutrophil-like cells (defined by high levels of FCGR3B and CSF3R expression)
verifications.reason: 作者明确用高表达 FCGR3B 定义 monocyte cluster 内的 neutrophil-like cells 亚群，并据此检出/命名该细胞群，符合 Marker 身份与注释用途双重门槛。旧判定仅因不在任务目标细胞范围而排除，按新口径不构成排除理由。

verifications.source_context: Upregulated genes were involved in pro-inflammatory and defense response pathways, (IFNG), trafficking-associated genes (GNAI2), activation-associated transcription factors (FOS, JUND) and canonical immune activation marker (CD69) (Fig. 3C).
verifications.reason: CD69 仅作为 CD8+ T 细胞中上调的 canonical immune activation marker / DEG 被展示，用于描述活化表型，未用于识别、命名或归类 CD8+ T 细胞，不满足注释用途门槛。
